cargoZones.label: @i18n:label
cargoZones.notes: Published 7-seat boot volume and rear cargo width are sourced; rectangular dimensions combine the sourced floor length/width with an estimated cuboid height for MVP packing. Soft bags fit more reliably than rigid boxes because the third-row seatbacks and tailgate trim reduce usable shape.
